posts.title: Pony Games Is Live!
posts.excerpt: Welcome to the first public release of Pony Games, a growing directory of fan-made pony games, jams, and dev resources. Questions, feedback, or a game to submit? Email littlehorseappreciator@proton.me. More updates soon!

posts.title: Resources update
posts.excerpt:
![](https://mare.by/PxQCUasr.png)

Around a month has passed since our last updates, we've been a bit busy but not idle! The next update is gonna be a big one!

For now here's what we've got:
* Resources page now has resources, go check it out! For now it's mostly the assets we used during the asset jam, but we'll upload stuff up for grabs in there every now and then. If you have something to submit email us using the email in the "about" page. We'll have a proper submission form in the future.
* 527 new games! Go check them out!
* New mirror "Autumn" ! More backups!
* 6 new themes plus one extra, because it was requested
* /mlp/ ring compatibility. Look at the footer!
* More visible NSFW and GORE toggles. Because some people were saying they were hard to see

/)
